turns.utterance: Now measure the cooling water flow rate. ground_truth.node_text: With the cooling circuit running, place an inline flow meter or a timed collection vessel at the cooling water outlet from the electrode holder body. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum cooling flow for this electrode size in the resistance welding machine specification. Low flow indicates a partially blocked cooling channel or a failing recirculation pump.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow measurement complete. I've recorded the flow rates at both electrode outlets and compared them to the spec.
